verdict: Meta is firing on all cylinders; Google spend is being corrected now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 118 leads at an average cost of $25.60 each, all of them driven by Meta. The standout story this week is Meta's efficiency: your cost per lead fell 43.63% while leads rose 33.33%, on less spend — the budget is simply working harder. On the other side, Google Ads consumed $1,950.18 this period and recorded zero conversions; its budget has been cut significantly while we verify attribution and determine the right path forward. On the CRM side, leads are being logged but no appointments or won opportunities are showing downstream, which points to an intake flow issue we are actively resolving — not an ads problem.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
drop in cost per lead week-over-week on Meta
spent on Google Ads this period with zero recorded conversions

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $1,950 this period with no recorded conversions, and leads are entering the CRM without progressing to appointments or closed opportunities.
watch_item.fix: Google's budget has already been reduced by more than half while conversion tracking is being repaired; the CRM intake flow is under review in parallel, with a full end-to-end stack re-test targeted for August 31.
